commits.message:
Place nine round-4 sub-exponential 3-SAT packets in SubexponentialSAT

File the fourth round of ETH refinement packets (arrival b9941a7396) under
Computability/SubexponentialSAT/Research, and retire their archives from
docs/incoming, which now holds only its README. Seven packets reviewed the
round-3 placement; 3sat_round3_frontier and eth_adaptive_schedules reviewed
only through round 2. All keep the SAT order n log log n/sqrt(log n), and
their coefficients are per normalized wire.

Retired archives, where each went, and what each claims:
- sat_adaptive_bounds (30 files): polynomial-space C = 46.185, the new
  smallest (from 55.709); cached 34.325/34.024; low-degree cached
  13.380/13.253.
- sat_adaptive_tree_certificate (43): cached 30.891 time / 30.754 space, the
  new smallest cached pair, from per-allocation choice among three
  contraction trees.
- sat_adaptive_frontier (39): polynomial 50.305; cached 31.252/31.252.
- sat_adaptive_matrix_partition (35): polynomial 50.210; cached
  34.325/34.024, the same pair as sat_adaptive_bounds, found independently.
- subexponential_sat_adaptive_four (35): cached 32.916/31.662 (32.856/31.467
  with a 19/8 backend); polynomial 50.394.
- subsat_rectangular (40): polynomial 53.978; cached 33.994/33.994;
  precision barriers.
- eth_adaptive_exact_kernels, from ETH_Adaptive_Exact_Kernels_2026-10-27.zip
  (93): polynomial 55.332 (25.164 at degree <= s^0.51); cached
  35.071/34.000; measured kernel speedups 1.46-2.73x. 58 sources/ snapshots
  are omitted.
- 3sat_round3_frontier (89): polynomial 63.757 and 23.666 at degree
  <= s^(1/12), the new low-degree polynomial-space best; cached
  37.930/33.623 and low-degree 14.239/12.361. 26 evidence/ copies omitted.
- eth_adaptive_schedules (39): polynomial 63.781; cached 37.592/33.623;
  an incremental matching-potential kernel.

Each archive was extracted with `py -I` into its own empty scratch directory
and checked for unsafe paths. 85 members are not filed: one SHA256SUMS
ledger (.gitignore policy) and 84 byte-identical copies of files at ProveIt
73dfb5e5ab or upstream, appended to Research/OMITTED.tsv. Duplicated
.py/.sh files are kept. Five CRLF tables are marked -text, and seven
delivered .log files are force-added past *.log. At Vladimir's request, no
separate manifest, omission or link recheck was run for this round. No
supplied script, test or build was run.

The project README gains a round-4 table and updated ladders. Polynomial
space now runs 18,535.75 -> ... -> 46.185, about 401x on the upper bound,
and the cached best is 30.891/30.754. The low-degree and measured-speedup
lists are extended. The docs/incoming table and the Computability index are
updated.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Link the anthropics/formal-math Lean development of eth.pdf

The Claude-credited manuscript "A 2^{o(n)} time algorithm for 3-SAT"
(Research/claude-2o-n-3sat/eth.pdf) said its Lean development would be
linked "when a public location exists". It is now public in
https://github.com/anthropics/formal-math, added by pull request
anthropics/formal-math#31 (commit 1a6eee293b9e00cb432eef6018a21f523623a9af,
merged as 16a5ce4130 on 2026-10-27).

Computability/SubexponentialSAT/README.md:
- The eth.pdf row now points to the published development instead of
  calling it unpublished.
- A new section, "Lean development of eth.pdf", links the repository, the
  PR's changes at that commit (as Vladimir asked), the commit, and the eth/
  tree at it. It summarises the contents as the PR describes them:
  MainResults.lean, Solution.lean, comparator.json, and the two sorry in
  Challenge.lean only. At the merge commit eth/ holds 1,062 files, 1,052 of
  them .lean.
- The section notes that eth/paper.pdf (900,337 bytes) is a different
  revision from the 868,673-byte eth.pdf filed here.

Computability/README.md links the eth/ tree from the project's entry.

The development is linked, not vendored, and nothing here builds or checks
it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
